items.question: Which customers were removed from our active base in Q1 2025 because they churned? Give how many per region.
items.answer: In Q1 2025, a total of 19 customers churned across various regions: 13 in North America, 3 in EMEA, 2 in APAC, and 1 in LATAM. The churned customers include Marco Kowalski and Nadia Yilmaz in APAC; Clara Sharma, Freya Costa, and Marco Fischer in EMEA; Marco Costa in LATAM; and Amara Moreau, Emma Bakker, Emma Fischer, Felix Rossi, Ines Yilmaz, Lena Reyes, Mia Yilmaz, Nils Tan, Noah Haddad, Pablo Farah, Sara Novak, Sofia Nakamura, and Zara Kowalski in North America.
